issues.detail: The Greek 'πρωι εννυχον' refers to the early morning hours (dawn/early morning), but the Vietnamese 'trời còn tối mịt' implies it was still pitch black/dark, which may misrepresent the timing of the dawn.
The Greek 'λιαν αναστας' means 'having risen very early'. The Vietnamese 'chờ dậy' (waiting to get up) is a mistranslation of 'αναστας' (having risen/getting up).
